summary: An advisory committee meeting of the Cardiovascular and Renal Products Advisory Committee was planned for NDA 206143 (ivabradine/Corlanor): it was scheduled for January 14, 2015, then postponed (review clock extended three months) to on or around April 14, 2015. However, the application was ultimately NOT referred to an advisory committee, and no meeting was held. The final approval letter states the application was not referred to an AC because it raised no unexpected safety/efficacy issues, no significant public-health questions, and needed no outside expertise; the AdminCorres completeness checklist likewise marks 'No AC meeting.' Because no committee convened, there was no vote and there are no committee-concern-to-change linkages.
